scenes.justification: Formula topology breaking down continuous compounding rate conversion R_c = m * ln(1 + R_m / m)

scenes.justification: Process topology showing the three-step causal architecture of coupon stripping

beats.visualIntent: Node 1: Market bond prices observed bundling periodic coupon cash flows
Node 2: Recursive coupon stripping discounting prior payments at known zero rates
Node 3: Final payment isolated to solve next zero rate and complete spot curve

scenes.justification: Worked example topology calculating 6-month Treasury bill continuous zero rate

beats.visualIntent: Given panel: Treasury bill price 97.50 dollars, face value 100 dollars, maturity 0.5 years
Step 1: Set 97.50 = 100*e^(-0.5*R), compute ratio 0.975, apply -ln(0.975) / 0.5
Result card: 6-month continuously compounded zero rate equals 0.05064 (5.064%)

scenes.justification: Comparison topology contrasting novice flat YTM myth against professional zero curves

beats.visualIntent: Novice trap: Single flat yield to maturity applied across all cash flow tenors
Professional reality: Unique spot zero rates discounting each cash flow independently
Par yield definition: Coupon rate causing bond theoretical price to equal face value

scenes.justification: Formula topology for forward rate extraction with prediction question and reveal

beats.visualIntent: Display forward rate formula R_F = (R_2*T_2 - R_1*T_1) / (T_2 - T_1)
Prediction question: 1-year rate 3% and 2-year rate 4%, calculate 0.04*2 - 0.03*1
Reveal step: 0.05 divided by 1 year gives forward rate 5.0% with no-arbitrage proof

scenes.justification: Quantity over time topology plotting zero curve against implied forward curve
